item.title: [8] Evolution of charge density wave soft phonon modes in PdxErTe3
item.description:
Last authors: Ian R. Fisher, Frank Weber

Authors: Avishek Maity, Stephan Rosenkranz, Raymond Osborn, et al.

Score 8/10 B_IMPORTANT_CONDMAT

Why: Experimental study of CDW and phonon softening in a telluride material system.

Tags: #material #topic

Abstract: Author(s): Avishek Maity, Stephan Rosenkranz, Raymond Osborn, Rolf Heid, Ayman H. Said, Ahmet Alatas, Joshua A. W. Straquadine, Matthew J. Krogstad, Anisha G. Singh, Ian R. Fisher, and Frank Weber Here, the authors use diffuse and inelastic x-ray scattering to investigate the dynamics of orthogonal charge density waves (CDWs) in Pd x ErTe 3 . Strong diffuse scattering and phonon softening persist at wave vector q a (|| a * ) equal in magnitude to the ordering vector q c (|| c * ) of the primary CDW, although small intercalation already suppresses the secondary CDW order near q a . The authors demonstrate that diffuse scattering and phonon softening at q a is coupled to fluctuations of the onset of the primary CDW for all intercalation levels. [Phys. Rev. B 113, 224101] Published Mon Jun 01, 2026
